title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 USD


The backend serves both a consumer-facing onboarding app and an internal admin operations dashboard.


Current Backend Stack:

  • GraphQL API server (single endpoint) likely built with NestJS + TypeGraphQL or similar Node.js/TypeScript framework
  • AWS Cognito for user authentication (SRP protocol, email + phone login, token refresh)
  • PostgreSQL database with relational schema (users, payments, vehicle loans, agreements, stage transitions)
  • Hosted on AWS (us-east-1 region)
  • Integrations: Plaid (bank linking), ACH payment processor, KYC/identity verification, PDF generation, e-sign


Backend Responsibilities:

  • 30+ GraphQL queries and 20+ mutations covering user lifecycle, payments, onboarding, and financial reporting
  • Multi-stage onboarding pipeline (11 stages):
  • signup → identity → bank link → cash flow → admin review → approval → micro-deposits → auto loan link → disclosure → payment setup → active
  • Payment scheduling, debt collection, refund processing
  • FBO (For Benefit Of) sub-ledger tracking
  • Credit line management and daily contribution calculations


Required Skills:

  • TypeScript / Node.js primary language
  • GraphQL schema design, resolvers, input validation (NestJS GraphQL module or Apollo Server)
  • PostgreSQL complex queries, migrations, enum types, indexing
  • AWS Cognito (SRP auth protocol), deployment (ECS / Lambda / AppSync)
  • Plaid API Link tokens, bank account verification, micro-deposits
  • ACH / Payment processing understanding of payment lifecycles, failed payment handling, refund flows (currently using Spinwheel.io)


Preferred Experience:

  • Fintech or payments industry background
  • FBO accounting / sub-ledger reconciliation
  • KYC / AML compliance workflows
  • E-sign / digital agreement flows
  • Multi-channel communications (SMS via Twilio, email via Resend)


Scope of Work:

  • Along with our partner, we are seeking someone to quickly modify and rewrite the onboarding process to reduce friction and delays. You will implement new features through the Plaid API and other onboarding processes to eliminate drop-off and improve customer experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build core systems at a fast-growing fintech company.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays



*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: GTM Builder
description:
GTM builder

You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...

You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

You Will:

• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows

• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning

• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations

• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory

• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution

• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: HubSpot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems

• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort

• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence

• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available

• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable

• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures

• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production

You Have:

• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly

• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)

• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows

• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability

• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems

• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data

• Experience with automation tools like N8N, Make, Zapier, or similar

• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines

• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast

• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions

• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities

• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems

• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows

• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work

• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Front End Technical lead-AI
description:
• Technical Lead, AI and Engineering
  • 100% Remote LATAM

This is a combination of Lead, Front end - React and Next JS hands on development, and Generative AI

Candidates should have been at a Lead capacity overseeing multiple projects. They could be a people manager as well - but should be hands on with development

Candidates have to clear React Hacker Rank coding test

Our client is building a scalable, AI-enabled platform that helps founders turn ideas into real ventures. As a Tech Lead, you’ll play a key role in shaping the core architecture and AI infrastructure, with real ownership over how the platform is designed, built, and scaled.

Job Description

Job Summary:

Lead development and implementation of complex information technology projects and architecture to solve problems with wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration.

The Technical Lead acts as the primary architectural authority and engineering manager for the platform. This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Technical Architecture & Strategy

  • Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives.
  • Make technical design choices and follow technical standards, including cyber security, software languages, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Balance fast, lean innovation with practical implementation, technical feasibility, technical debt, and system stability in production environments.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to platform needs and understand risk mitigation strategies.

Engineering Leadership & Priorities

  • Manage the engineering team in alignment with product roadmap and critical deadlines.
  • Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical specs and engineering tasks.
  • Mentor software developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure high-quality coding.
  • Oversee the software product development lifecycle, including MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and release management, as well as data pipelines, and governance.

Product Collaboration

  • Partner with the Product Team, Designers, and Business Director to align on strategic priorities, estimate development effort, and define timelines.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders including executives and customers.

Ethics & Risk Management

  • Ensure responsible data management and AI practices (fairness, transparency, and data privacy) and ensure governance frameworks for AI model deployment and monitoring.
  • Navigate regulatory requirements, security needs, and compliance consideration.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
  • 8+ years of Software Engineering (ideally AI-focused) experience, including 2+ years in a Lead Engineer, Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role

Core Technical Expertise:

Deep understanding of and strong hands-on experience with:

  • Application & Product Engineering
  • Modern web application architecture, including frontend, middleware, backend, and full-stack development
  • Languages and frameworks including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, NextJS, React, Node.js, and SQL
  • APIs, Services & Data
  • Microservices and API design, including REST and GraphQL
  • Asynchronous and event-driven systems
  • Authentication and authorization
  • Data and storage systems (relational, NoSQL, and vector databases)
  • Cloud Platforms & Infrastructure
  • Cloud-native and distributed systems design
  • Containerization and orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Docker)
  • AWS , including Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and IAM
  • Additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and cloud-agnostic design principles
  • DevOps, MLOps & Delivery

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.
  • Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability.
  • Innovate and follow best practices.
  • Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.
  • Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent)
  • Good understanding of databases
  • You have built large-scale data products and understand the tradeoffs made when building these features
  • You have a deep understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms
  • You have an excellent knowledge of distributed computing frameworks such as Hadoop MapReduce, Spark
  • You have a strong knowledge of following AWS infrastructure - EMR, S3, Lambda, Redshift etc
  • You have strong understanding of data quality, governance
  • You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things


Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Developer in Spyglass
description:
Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone


Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Analista de Negócios (Dados)
description:
Descrição:


• Conduzir estudos quantitativos de negócio de forma autônoma, desde a formulação de hipóteses até a extração de dados, modelagem e geração de recomendações estratégicas;

• Identificar oportunidades de crescimento no canal App por meio de análises estatísticas — correlações, segmentação de clientes, análise de propensão e modelos de regressão aplicados a comportamento de contratação;

• Acompanhar os indicadores de performance do canal digital (funil de conversão, ticket médio, volume de contratos), diagnosticando desvios e propondo ações corretivas com embasamento em dados;

• Contribuir na concepção de novas funcionalidades e jornadas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia com visão orientada a dados;

• Construir e manter dashboards analíticos em Power BI ou ferramentas similares, garantindo visibilidade dos KPIs para a liderança;

• Agir proativamente na identificação e remoção de obstáculos ao desempenho da equipe, trazendo dados como base para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:


• Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Física ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa;

• Experiência comprovada com análise estatística aplicada a negócio: correlação, regressão, testes de hipótese e significância estatística;

• Capacidade de extrair, processar e analisar dados de forma autônoma, sem dependência de time de dados dedicado;

• Domínio de SQL para consultas analíticas (incluindo joins complexos, agregações e subqueries);

• Conhecimento em Power BI e Excel avançado (modelagem de dados, DAX, tabelas dinâmicas, análises estatísticas);

• Experiência prévia em setor financeiro ou bancário, com compreensão de produtos de crédito, canais digitais ou comportamento do cliente em apps.


Desejáveis:


• Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados e modelagem estatística;

• Conhecimento em Snowflake, BigQuery ou outro data warehouse moderno;

• Vivência com testes A/B — incluindo definição de significância estatística, tamanho de amostra e interpretação dos resultados;

• Atuação prévia com canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

• Acompanhar os indicadores de performance do canal digital (funil de conversão, ticket médio, volume de contratos), diagnosticando desvios e propondo ações corretivas com embasamento em dados;

• Contribuir na concepção de novas funcionalidades e jornadas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia com visão orientada a dados;

• Construir e manter dashboards analíticos em Power BI ou ferramentas similares, garantindo visibilidade dos KPIs para a liderança;

• Agir proativamente na identificação e remoção de obstáculos ao desempenho da equipe, trazendo dados como base para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:


• Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Física ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa;

• Experiência comprovada com análise estatística aplicada a negócio: correlação, regressão, testes de hipótese e significância estatística;

• Capacidade de extrair, processar e analisar dados de forma autônoma, sem dependência de time de dados dedicado;

• Domínio de SQL para consultas analíticas (incluindo joins complexos, agregações e subqueries);

• Conhecimento em Power BI e Excel avançado (modelagem de dados, DAX, tabelas dinâmicas, análises estatísticas);

• Experiência prévia em setor financeiro ou bancário, com compreensão de produtos de crédito, canais digitais ou comportamento do cliente em apps.


Desejáveis:


• Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados e modelagem estatística;

• Conhecimento em Snowflake, BigQuery ou outro data warehouse moderno;

• Vivência com testes A/B — incluindo definição de significância estatística, tamanho de amostra e interpretação dos resultados;

• Atuação prévia com canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno


Atuará na sustentação, evolução e otimização da infraestrutura, com forte atuação em cloud AWS e integração com ambientes on-premises.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na administração e suporte de ambientes de infraestrutura híbrida (on-premises e cloud AWS)
  • Gerenciar e provisionar recursos na AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, ECS, entre outros)
  • Monitorar desempenho, disponibilidade e segurança dos ambientes
  • Implementar melhorias contínuas em arquitetura e processos de infraestrutura
  • Administrar sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Suportar e interagir com bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle e MySQL)
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e operações na resolução de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Documentar ambientes, processos e procedimentos técnicos


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Analista de Infraestrutura (nível pleno)
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em cloud AWS
  • Experiência com ambientes híbridos
  • Administração de sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Vivência com bancos de dados SQL Server, Oracle e MySQL
  • Conhecimento em redes, segurança e monitoramento


Diferenciais

  • Certificação AWS

  • Perfil analítico e proativo
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Organização e foco em resolução de problemas

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Cobol Pleno
description:
Key Responsibilities

•Realizar manutenções e desenvolvimento de aplicações Cobol para plataformas Mainframe Unisys;

• Definição de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

• Definir solução técnica, fazer estimativas de esforço e prazos, assegurando a entrega dentro do cronograma estabelecido.;

• Codificar e realizar testes unitários;

• Atuar em colaboração com o time diariamente para avaliar progresso das atividades e avaliar riscos de projeto, promovendo uma abordagem proativa na resolução de problemas.;

• Contribuir de forma multidisciplinar com objetivo de ajudar o time a atingir as metas, participando ativamente em discussões e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário;

• Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, incentivando a inovação e aprimoramento contínuo.


Key Qualifications

• Conhecimento e experiencia com desenvolvimento de aplicação utilizando Cobol

• Conhecimento e experiencia de trabalho em equipe com métodos ágeis SCRUM ou Kanban, capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, entrega incremental e foco na qualidade e valor do produto;

• Graduação: Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

• Experiência com processos da engenharia de software e desenvolvimento de sistemas, incluindo analise, design, implementação, testes e manutenção;

• Experiencia desenvolvimento ambiente mainframe Unisys, COMS, DMSII, SDF, CANDE

• Conhecimento em testes unitários e de integração automatizados (TDD/ATDD) em rotinas COBOL.

Conhecimento em metodologia BDD;

• Ser flexível, colaborativo e proativo;

• Empatia, capacidade de colaborar em equipe e excelente relacionamento interpessoal;

• Buscar aprendizado constantemente;

• Iniciativa, tomada de decisão e atitude de liderança, Inteligência Emocional.

•Realizar manutenções e desenvolvimento de aplicações Cobol para plataformas Mainframe Unisys;

• Definição de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

• Definir solução técnica, fazer estimativas de esforço e prazos, assegurando a entrega dentro do cronograma estabelecido.;

• Codificar e realizar testes unitários;

• Atuar em colaboração com o time diariamente para avaliar progresso das atividades e avaliar riscos de projeto, promovendo uma abordagem proativa na resolução de problemas.;

• Contribuir de forma multidisciplinar com objetivo de ajudar o time a atingir as metas, participando ativamente em discussões e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário;

• Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, incentivando a inovação e aprimoramento contínuo.


Key Qualifications

• Conhecimento e experiencia com desenvolvimento de aplicação utilizando Cobol

• Conhecimento e experiencia de trabalho em equipe com métodos ágeis SCRUM ou Kanban, capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, entrega incremental e foco na qualidade e valor do produto;

• Graduação: Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

• Experiência com processos da engenharia de software e desenvolvimento de sistemas, incluindo analise, design, implementação, testes e manutenção;

• Experiencia desenvolvimento ambiente mainframe Unisys, COMS, DMSII, SDF, CANDE

• Conhecimento em testes unitários e de integração automatizados (TDD/ATDD) em rotinas COBOL.

Conhecimento em metodologia BDD;

• Ser flexível, colaborativo e proativo;

• Empatia, capacidade de colaborar em equipe e excelente relacionamento interpessoal;

• Buscar aprendizado constantemente;

• Iniciativa, tomada de decisão e atitude de liderança, Inteligência Emocional.

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Negócios (B2B)
description:
NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?


Somos uma fintech que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!


Desde 2019, o aplicativo Grana simplifica o cálculo de Imposto de Renda para investidores da bolsa. Hoje, estamos expandindo nossa atuação com novos produtos:

  • Grana Pro, voltado para contadores e assessores que atendem investidores;
  • Grana Smart, que utiliza Open Finance e Inteligência Artificial para dar mais clareza e controle sobre a vida financeira das pessoas.


Estamos em um momento de construção e crescimento, abrindo novas frentes, testando caminhos e evoluindo nossos produtos com base em quem usa.


Conheça mais sobre nossa proposta e funcionalidades em:



DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


O Grana Pro é nossa frente B2B e está em fase de construção. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na linha de frente desse crescimento, ajudando a desenvolver e escalar a base de clientes.


Essa posição envolve desde a prospecção e apresentação do produto até o acompanhamento do cliente ao longo da jornada, com um papel ativo na construção da estratégia comercial e na evolução do produto.


Aqui, você terá autonomia, contato direto com o mercado e a oportunidade real de construir algo do zero.


Se isso te descreve, essa vaga é para você!

title: .NET Software Engineer
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of \"large company\" in 2018. We now have more than 400 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a \"Lifetime Experience\" where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or similar;
  • 5–6 years of experience in .NET development;
  • Strong knowledge of C# and object-oriented programming principles;
  • Experience with microservice architecture and RESTful APIs;
  • Solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms;
  • Proficiency with ADO.NET and Entity Framework;
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

Let's chat! Send your application and take a look at:

title: Full Stack Engineer (Java/Angular) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Java development;
  • Experience with cloud environments and modern backend systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Experience working with Apache Kafka;
  • Experience with Angular for frontend development;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer


Technical Requirements

  • Expert level proficiency in React Native for building highperformance reusable components for both iOS and Android
  • State Management Mastery of Redux, MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence
  • Experience writing Native Bridges JavaKotlin for Android Objective CSwift for iOS to access device specific features not covered by standard React Native APIs
  • Deep expertise in optimizing app render times, memory usage and battery consumption
  • Navigation Proficiency with React Navigation or React Native Navigation for complex screen flows
  • Mobile Ecosystem Tooling
  • Expert use of Metro Bundler, Xcode and Android Studio for building debugging and profiling applications
  • Experience managing the end-to-end release process for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store including TestFlight and Beta testing
  • Code Push Proficiency in using Microsoft CodePush for overtheair OTA updates to bypass traditional store review cycles for critical hotfixes


Secondary Technical Skills: Integration DevOps

  • Backend API Integration
  • REST GraphQL Deep understanding of consuming complex APIs handling authentication OAuth2JWT and managing data synchronization
  • Experience implementing offline capabilities using WatermelonDB Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity
  • Mobile DevOps Quality
  • CI/CD Pipelines Experience with Fastlane, Bitrise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines
  • Testing Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end-to-end E2E automation
  • Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing


Key Responsibilities: AMS Context

  • Mobile App Support Lead the resolution of Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents affecting global mobile users from UI glitches to critical sync failures
  • OS Compatibility Proactively manage app updates to ensure compatibility with the latest iOS and Android versions and hardware releases
  • Complex Change Requests Translate requirements from Sales and Marketing leads into technical mobile features Design develop and test enhancements
  • Root Cause Analysis RCA Perform deepdive analysis on app crashes API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes
  • SLA Stewardship Ensure all mobile services meet strict Service Level Agreements SLAs for our 24/7 global field operations
  • Technical Mentorship Act as the Subject Matter Expert SME for React Native in the India hub providing guidance to junior developers and UI/UX designers


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with TypeScript for typesafe React Native development
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori for mobile or SAP Mobile Services
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth IoT integration for warehouse scanning applications
  • Experience with mobile security best practices biometrics certificate pinning

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
  • Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Specialist
description:
Role : Subject Matter Expert(Medical - Brazil)

Engagement : Freelancing

Rate per hour : 35 usd per hour

Time commitment per day : 4- 6 hours per day

Duration of the project: 6 months



Role Overview

We are seeking licensed medical professionals with active clinical practice and exposure to the Brazi l healthcare system to support medical review, evaluation, and knowledge‑driven initiatives. This role emphasizes practical clinical expertise over purely academic depth and values professionals who actively engage in both patient care and teaching/mentoring .

  • Experience: Minimum 2+ years of experience in medical education
  • Licensure:Licensed practicing doctor
  • Professional engagement: Actively involved in clinical practice
  • Concurrent involvement in teaching, mentoring, or medical training

title: Citrix Engineer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 4 years as a Citrix Engineer ;
  • Experience with Citrix Legacy (produts);
  • Knowledge of Citrix Cloud;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.
